claims: C1 using the model to facilitate a critical or high severity harm is forbidden
C2 acts of violence are critical or high severity harms
C3 creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons are critical or high severity harms
C4 terrorism is a critical or high severity harm
C5 child abuse is a critical or high severity harm
C6 persecution is a critical or high severity harm
C7 mass surveillance is a critical or high severity harm

concepts.name: critical_high_severity_harm
concepts.gloss: H is a harm of critical or high severity that the clause forbids the model from facilitating

concepts.name: model_use
concepts.gloss: U is an event in which the model is used
concepts.inference: the clause regulates uses of the model, so the case must identify which events are model uses

concepts.name: facilitates
concepts.gloss: model use U facilitates harm H
concepts.inference: the prohibition attaches to uses that facilitate a harm, so the case must supply that relation

concepts.name: act_of_violence
concepts.gloss: H is an act of violence, such as crimes against humanity, war crimes, genocide, torture, human trafficking, or forced labor
concepts.inference: the clause treats acts of violence as an example of critical or high severity harms; classifying an event as such is a case-side fact

concepts.name: creation_cbn_weapon
concepts.gloss: H is the creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons, including weapons of mass destruction
concepts.inference: the clause treats creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons as an example of critical or high severity harms; classifying an event as such is a case-side fact

concepts.name: terrorism
concepts.gloss: H is an act of terrorism
concepts.inference: the clause treats terrorism as an example of a critical or high severity harm; classifying an event as such is a case-side fact

concepts.name: child_abuse
concepts.gloss: H is an act of child abuse, such as the creation of child sexual abuse material
concepts.inference: the clause treats child abuse as an example of a critical or high severity harm; classifying an event as such is a case-side fact

concepts.name: persecution
concepts.gloss: H is an act of persecution
concepts.inference: the clause treats persecution as an example of a critical or high severity harm; classifying an event as such is a case-side fact

concepts.name: mass_surveillance
concepts.gloss: H is an act of mass surveillance
concepts.inference: the clause treats mass surveillance as an example of a critical or high severity harm; classifying an event as such is a case-side fact

ontology.gloss: an act of violence is a critical or high severity harm
creation of cyber, biological, or nuclear weapons is a critical or high severity harm
terrorism is a critical or high severity harm

persecution is a critical or high severity harm

asserts.read_back: using the model via % to facilitate % is forbidden because % is a critical or high severity harm

closure.reason: the clause forbids only model uses that facilitate critical or high severity harms; a model use that facilitates no such harm is outside the prohibition, so silence permits it
